title: Revision Sprint
description: CAT 100 textbook section on revision sprinting, centered on a revision sprint log, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the revision sprint log shows a defensible decision in CAT 100.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it.
